steps: Enumerated all worktree registrations across the fleet: `for r in */; do git -C $r worktree list --porcelain; done` -> 22 registrations total (1 each in 19 lanes; lore 20 incl. main; gd2d 6 incl. main). 21 of them are prunable candidates.

For each of the 21: `test -e <path>` -> all absent (no PRESENT! line); `git -C <owner> log --oneline <HEAD> --not --all | wc -l` -> 0; admin dir HEAD file vs registration HEAD -> match; `ls <admin>/locked` -> ENOENT (unlocked); `ls -l /proc/*/cwd | grep -E 'r87-|r80-baseline|r81-frozen'` -> empty (no live cwd).
Fleet-wide uniqueness: counted registrations of each basename across every *-shokunin repo -> exactly 1 for all 21.

Hidden-aware live-pin sweep (the S43 correction: ripgrep skips dot-dirs unless --hidden): `rg -l --no-ignore --hidden -F <name> . -g '!.git' -g '!souji-shokunin/census/**' -g '!souji-shokunin/tests/**'` -> every hit classified historical (see live_pin_sweep).

Index-residue audit: `GIT_INDEX_FILE=<admin>/index git diff-index --cached --name-only <HEAD>` for all 19 lore admin dirs -> 16 clean, 3 with staged-only entries (r87-F1 24, r87-M1-myth 8, r87-M3 9).

Recoverability proof for the 3 residues: per-blob `git rev-list --all --objects | grep -c ^<blob>` and, for the unreachable M1-myth blobs, reconstruction from the tracked patch with git-blob hashing (8/8 sha1 match).

Hazard check: `git -C game-dev-2d-shokunin worktree prune --dry-run -v` -> lists ALL 5 gd2d registrations including the 3 must-survive wt-r98/99/100; `git -C lore-shokunin worktree prune --dry-run -v | wc -l` -> 19 (exactly the candidate set, nothing else).

Their tips exist only in refs/heads (68bee6e7 / fe1a996e / 2d562282) and would survive a metadata prune, but the unpushed work is exactly the SKILL 'unpushed-lane trap'. Operator disposition required.

why_it_does_not_block_under_the_artifact: PROVINCE.md / SKILL.md block 'any artifact whose owning lane has dirty or unpushed work TOUCHING IT'. Checked precisely: `git -C lore-shokunin log --name-only --format='' --branches --not --remotes` -> .gitignore and .ufo/waves/round-100/** only; grep for 'worktrees/' -> 0 files. `git -C game-dev-2d-shokunin log --name-only --format='' --branches --not --remotes | grep -c 'worktrees/'` -> 0. No unpushed commit touches any admin dir or any of the 21 target paths.
The registration metadata (.git/worktrees/<name>/) is untracked git state; no commit in either lane can touch it, so the gate can never fire on it as written.
lane_state_caveat.if_stricter_reading_is_applied: If the operator instead requires the owning lane to be entirely clean (no unpushed commits at all), then all 21 authorizations flip to FALSE until lore's 3 and gd2d's 6 unpushed commits are pushed. Flagged explicitly because PROVINCE's sentence admits both readings.

This is the only target with an unreferenced-content residue.
lore-shokunin carries 1 pre-existing dangling tree (79d0839f8b130cca29d4ac7af2cf520c468615d9, `git fsck --dangling`), unrelated to these registrations.

Metadata prune deletes each admin dir's index (lore ~286 KB each, gd2d ~16.7-21.8 MB each) and worktree-local reflog. It does NOT touch refs/heads, so no commit is lost (confirms S61's correction of S52's framing).
Reclaimed disk is modest: lore ~5.4 MB total across 19 registrations; gd2d ~77 MB across the 2 authorized ones. This is metadata hygiene, not a space win.
